overview: NITI Aayog serves as the apex public policy think tank of the Government of India, tasked with catalyzing economic development and fostering cooperative federalism through the involvement of State Governments in economic policymaking using a bottom-up approach. It provides strategic, functional, and technical inputs to the Prime Minister and Government at all levels, focusing on areas such as agriculture, social sectors, innovation, frontier technologies, manufacturing, services, smart urbanization, mobility, clean energy, improved governance, and aspirational districts. NITI Aayog also monitors and evaluates government programmes, promotes innovation and entrepreneurship through initiatives like Atal Innovation Mission, and fosters partnerships with stakeholders including academia, industry, and international think tanks.
objectives: Evolve a shared vision of national development priorities, sectors, and strategies with active involvement of States
Foster cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives with States
Develop mechanisms to formulate credible plans at the village level and aggregate them at higher levels of government
Ensure national security interests are incorporated in economic strategy and policy for referred areas
Pay special attention to sections of society at risk of not benefiting adequately from economic progress
Design strategic and long-term policy and programme frameworks, monitor their progress and efficacy, and use feedback for innovative improvements
Provide advice and encourage partnerships between key stakeholders and national/international think tanks, educational and policy research institutions
Create a knowledge, innovation, and entrepreneurial support system through a collaborative community of experts and practitioners
Offer a platform for resolution of inter-sectoral and inter-departmental issues to accelerate development agenda implementation
Maintain a state-of-the-art resource centre for research on good governance and best practices in sustainable and equitable development
Actively monitor and evaluate programme implementation, identify needed resources to strengthen success probability and scope of delivery
Focus on technology upgradation and capacity building for programme implementation
Undertake other activities necessary to further the execution of the national development agenda
eligibility: NITI Aayog serves as the apex public policy think tank of the Government of India, and the nodal agency tasked with catalysing economic development and fostering cooperative federalism through the involvement of State Governments in the economic policymaking process using a bottom-up approach.
benefits: NITI Aayog provides strategic, functional, and technical inputs to the Prime Minister and Government at all levels; fosters cooperative federalism through structured support initiatives with States; develops mechanisms to formulate credible plans at the village level and aggregate them at higher levels of government; ensures national security interests are incorporated in economic strategy and policy; pays special attention to sections of society at risk of not benefiting adequately from economic progress; designs strategic and long-term policy and programme frameworks, monitors their progress and efficacy, and uses feedback for innovative improvements; provides advice and encourages partnerships between key stakeholders and national/international like-minded think tanks, educational and policy research institutions; creates a knowledge, innovation, and entrepreneurial support system through a collaborative community of national and international experts, practitioners, and other partners; offers a platform for resolution of inter-sectoral and inter-departmental issues to accelerate development agenda implementation; maintains a state-of-the-art resource centre as a repository of research on good governance and best practices in sustainable and equitable development, and helps disseminate findings to stakeholders; actively monitors and evaluates programme implementation, identifies needed resources to strengthen success probability and scope of delivery; focuses on technology upgradation and capacity building for programme implementation; and undertakes other activities necessary to further the execution of the national development agenda.
financial_support: NITI Aayog is supported by an attached office, Development Monitoring and Evaluation Organisation (DMEO), a flagship initiative, Atal Innovation Mission (AIM), and an autonomous body, National Institute of Labour Economics Research and Development (NILERD). Its entire gamut of activities is divided into four main heads: Policy and Programme Framework, Cooperative Federalism, Monitoring and Evaluation, Think Tank, and Knowledge and Innovation Hub. The different divisions, cells, attached and autonomous bodies provide the requisite coordination and support framework needed to carry out its mandate.
implementing_agency: NITI Aayog, National Institution for Transforming India, Government of India
